name: decide
description: Mine the live session for the decisions that are actually blocking work, frame each one so it can be decided in place, optionally convene an expert panel as input, publish a shareable Decision Board, collect the human's call per item, and record what was decided — including what was decided against and why. Replaces the ad-hoc mid-thread question round, never a dispatched /interrogate a conductor requires: a question that GATHERS INFORMATION is an interrogation (/interrogate), a question that UNBLOCKS WORK is a decision (here). Fires preemptively on a conductor's cadence so a parallel run keeps moving without the operator asking to be asked, and every item names what deciding it unblocks. A building block: it surfaces, asks, and records — it never executes the decided work, and it never tallies a vote across people.
